NHS is under a lot of pressure, for years there’s not been enough resources provided, and that means every GP surgery is under a lot of pressure. People should take that into account when moaning about this surgery (instead of moaning about the continued aiming of NHS funds at private organisations rather than the NHS itself).

I had an extremely painful issue with my hip. I called up and, because I couldn’t think clearly enough to use the surgery website, the reception, despite being very busy, was extremely helpful. There were no appointments available but I had a call that day which meant I could get some pain medication prior to the night. There were no appointments available for some time but they squeezed me in on the Friday (I called Wednesday).
